title: Restart OptiSweep service when heartbeat is flat-lined (Ignition/WCS startup delay)
summary: If the heartbeat indicator is flat-lined, the source associates it with an unplanned restart condition where Ignition likely came up later than WCS/AGV (or takes longer on startup). In that case, restart the OptiSweep Windows service and confirm the heartbeat is no longer flat-lined.
when_to_use: Use when the OptiSweep heartbeat indicator is flat-lined and you need to restore OptiSweep availability by restarting the OptiSweep service, per the source’s guidance that Ignition startup timing can delay OptiSweep and lead to this condition.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the OptiSweep Windows service restart and verify the heartbeat indicator returns to a non-flat-lined state.
access_or_tools_needed: Windows Services (to restart/verify OptiSweep service status as shown in the source screenshot)
Heartbeat indicator (as referenced by the source)

access_required: Access to the Windows Services view to manage the OptiSweep service
system_preconditions: OptiSweep is present as a Windows service entry (with Status/Startup Type fields visible in the Services list)
